headline: Lead SRE | Observability | AIOps | Reliability Engineering
page_title: Rajendra P N - Lead SRE & Observability Engineer
summary_html: Lead SRE with 10+ years of experience in production operations, cloud platforms, and enterprise delivery. Advances engineering-led operations through SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, observability, toil reduction, and AIOps. Builds service-health dashboards and automation with Python, Terraform, Ansible, and Jenkins; correlates metrics, logs, and traces to guide incident response and reliability improvements. Leads production-readiness reviews, resiliency initiatives, and operational enablement across Azure/AWS and on-premises services, partnering with application, infrastructure, security, and governance teams.
